sections.script: Welcome to Detención Defensa, with Sorrentino Law Firm. We work with realtors, mortgage brokers, and business brokers. We built this website to help you make a plan.

sections.script: Where do you stand today? What are your choices? How do you protect your family, your home, and your business? Here is how it works.

caption_cues.text: Where do you stand today?
What are your choices?
How do you protect your family, your home, and your business?
Here is how it works.

sections.script: You worked hard for everything you have. Before you spend money on any plan, learn where you really stand.

caption_cues.text: You worked hard for everything you have.
Before you spend money on any plan, learn where you really stand.

sections.script: Step one. If ICE comes to you, stay calm. Do not run. Do not fight or push. That can put you in danger, and it can lead to new charges.

caption_cues.text: Step one.

sections.script: Step two. Fill out the questions. Tell us when you came, your country, your papers, any court orders, and if you have TPS. I will review your answers myself. Your answers help us determine whether additional immigration defense is appropriate, or whether you should plan for self-deportation or deportation.

caption_cues.text: Step two.

I will review your answers myself.

or whether you should plan for self-deportation or deportation.

sections.script: Then we give you an honest answer about where you stand and what we can do. You will get an email that explains your options and next steps: staying, leaving, or more immigration defense. Our team offers this help at a discount. Filling out the website does not make us your lawyers. That starts when we agree to work together.

sections.script: Step three. Your home. The value in your home can help pay for moving, bills, taxes, or legal help. The questions ask about your home and mortgage, and we review them. Your choices may include an approved loan, selling, renting, letting family live there, or putting it in a trust. A loan adds debt. A trust does not erase your mortgage, and no plan can promise protection from creditors. We will send you to Save My Home to learn more.

sections.script: Step four. Your business. Your gardening, landscaping, plumbing, handyman, or pool customers can be worth real money. We can help set up a corporation owned by a trust. That can help you sell the business, transfer it, or have someone run it while you still own it, even from another country, where the law allows. Results are not guaranteed. We will send you to Save My Business, at SaveMyBusiness.com.

sections.script: Step five. If you are detained, we look at whether there are grounds to challenge the detention in federal court. This is called habeas corpus. A judge decides if holding you is legal. It does not promise release, and you could be detained again later. If you qualify for our document offer, we prepare the papers at no charge, so you can file them yourself. This is called pro se. It is not the same as us going to court for you.

sections.script: Step six. Get your family papers ready. Your A-number. Who can care for your children, talk to the school, and make medical choices. Who can pay bills, handle your home, and hire a lawyer for you. And your car information, so someone can ask to get your car back if it is towed. We put together the family papers that apply to you, at no charge. Download them, check them, print, and sign. Get them witnessed or notarized if needed. Keep them safe, and tell someone you trust where they are.

sections.script: Step seven. Download the free emergency app, and set it up now, before you need it. Add your emergency contacts. If it is safe, press and hold the SOS button. It sends your phone's location at that moment, and alerts your contacts and our response team.

sections.script: That location shows where you were when you pressed the button. It helps us start looking. It does not follow your car after it is towed, and it does not track ICE. Our team checks the detention records that are available to help find you.

sections.script: Bienvenido a Detención Defensa, con Sorrentino Law Firm. Trabajamos con agentes inmobiliarios, corredores hipotecarios y corredores de negocios. Creamos este sitio web para ayudarle a hacer un plan.

sections.slide_title: Si llega ICE: mantenga la calma
sections.script: Paso uno. Si ICE se le acerca, mantenga la calma. No corra. No pelee ni empuje. Eso puede ponerle en peligro, y puede traerle nuevos cargos.

sections.script: Paso dos. Responda las preguntas. Díganos cuándo llegó, su país, sus papeles, cualquier orden de la corte, y si tiene TPS. Yo mismo revisaré sus respuestas. Sus respuestas nos ayudan a determinar si una defensa migratoria adicional es apropiada, o si usted debe planificar para la autodeportación o la deportación.

sections.script: Luego le damos una respuesta honesta sobre dónde está y qué podemos hacer. Recibirá un correo electrónico que explica sus opciones y los próximos pasos: quedarse, irse, o más defensa migratoria. Nuestro equipo ofrece esta ayuda con descuento. Llenar el sitio web no nos convierte en sus abogados. Eso empieza cuando acordamos trabajar juntos.

sections.script: Paso tres. Su casa. El valor de su casa puede ayudar a pagar la mudanza, las cuentas, los impuestos o la ayuda legal. Las preguntas piden datos de su casa y su hipoteca, y nosotros los revisamos. Sus opciones pueden incluir un préstamo aprobado, vender, alquilar, dejar que su familia viva allí, o ponerla en un fideicomiso. Un préstamo añade deuda. Un fideicomiso no borra su hipoteca, y ningún plan puede prometer protección contra acreedores. Le enviaremos a Salve Mi Casa para saber más.

sections.script: Paso cuatro. Su negocio. Sus clientes de jardinería, paisajismo, plomería, mantenimiento o piscinas pueden valer dinero de verdad. Podemos ayudarle a crear una corporación que sea propiedad de un fideicomiso. Eso puede ayudarle a vender el negocio, transferirlo, o tener a alguien que lo maneje mientras usted sigue siendo el dueño, incluso desde otro país, donde la ley lo permita. Los resultados no están garantizados. Le enviaremos a Salve Mi Negocio, en SaveMyBusiness.com.

sections.script: Paso cinco. Si lo detienen, revisamos si hay motivos para impugnar la detención en la corte federal. Esto se llama hábeas corpus. Un juez decide si detenerle es legal. Esto se llama pro se. No es lo mismo que nosotros vayamos a la corte por usted.

Ekip nou an tcheke dosye detansyon ki disponib yo pou ede jwenn ou.

sections.script: Men sa pou w fè. Reponn kesyon yo jodi a. Mwen pral revize repons ou yo. W ap resevwa yon imèl ak yon repons onèt ak pwochen etap ou yo. Apre sa, telechaje aplikasyon an, epi vizite Save My Home oswa Save My Business si yo bon pou ou.
